welcome.blurb: Mobile-first social deduction. Stealth night, automated narrator or assisted Master — with no signals that betray who is awake.

rules.title: Rules
rules.blurb: How a Nocturna night unfolds — for everyone at the table.

goal.title: Goal
goal.body:
Two main sides face each other under the same moon.

• Village wins when every Shadow is gone.
• Shadows win when they equal or outnumber the living Villagers.
• Solo / Neutral wanderers may win alone if they are the last one standing.

Never show your role card. Lying is allowed; revealing your private screen is not.

phases.title: Phases
phases.body:
A round moves through:

1. Night — eyes closed; protectors and investigators wake first, then the Shadows hunt, then other night roles — all in silence on their phones.
2. Dawn — the fallen (if any) are announced.
3. Discussion — talk, accuse, defend.
4. Tribunal — vote to eliminate someone you believe is a Shadow (ties follow Host settings).

Then the cycle repeats until a side wins. As a rule of thumb, about one Shadow hunter per five seats keeps the table tense without an auto-loss.

night.title: Night stealth
night.body:
During Night every phone stays dark. Nobody should learn who is awake from light, sound, or vibration.

If haptics are on, every device buzzes the same way. Ambient audio (automated mode) is the same loop for everyone.

Confirming early never ends the wake early — the timer masks who acted first.

day.title: Day & tribunal
day.body:
At dawn, victims of the night (if any) are revealed.

In Discussion you argue freely. In Tribunal you vote. Ties can mean no elimination or a runoff — the Host chooses before the game starts.

Votes may be secret or public, depending on Host settings.

modes.title: Game modes
modes.body:
• Automated narrator — the server calls each night wake on a timer. Everyone is a player.
• Assisted Master — one person narrates with a God-View dashboard, can pause, force-advance, and cancel actions. The Master is not dealt a role and does not count for win checks.

stealth.title: Table etiquette
stealth.body: Keep phones face-down when sleeping. Do not peek at neighbours. Dead players stay silent about their role. The Host’s QR / join link is always a LAN address — never localhost on player phones.

lobby.title: Lobby · PIN
lobby.scanQr: Scan to join from any phone.
lobby.hapticsHelp: Default: phones stay silent. “Universal heartbeat” buzzes every phone the same way when a night turn changes — so nobody can tell who woke from vibration alone.
lobby.ambientAudioHelp: Soft background loop on every device during automated nights only — same sound for everyone, no role-specific cues.
lobby.voteVisibilityHelp: Secret: votes stay hidden until the tally. Public: the table can see ballots as they come in.
lobby.tieBreakHelp: No elimination: a tie means nobody is burned. Runoff: only the tied players are voted on again.
lobby.nightTurnHelp: Default length of each night wake when the role has no longer wake window. Everyone waits the full window so finishing early does not leak who acted.
lobby.assistedMultHelp: In Master-assisted mode, soft timers can run longer (duration × this factor) so the Master has time to narrate. Automated mode ignores this.
lobby.allowLateJoinHelp: If on, players may still enter the PIN after the game started — they join as spectators without a dealt role.
lobby.modeHelp: Automated: the server calls night turns on a timer. Assisted: a Master advances turns and sees the God-View.
lobby.waitingHost: Waiting for the Host to configure and start…
lobby.lanError: No reachable LAN address. Connect the Host to Wi‑Fi or set an advertise override — localhost is not allowed.
lobby.recommendedHelp: One-tap decks for {{count}} players at the table (excluding a non-playing Master). Presets run from 6 to 24 seats.
lobby.recommendedApplied: Recommended deck applied. You can still edit roles below.
lobby.recommendedBalanceHint: Shadow hunters stay ~20–28% of seats; Custode + investigator always present; heavy specials only on large tables.

roles.guideHelp: These are the roles in the current Nocturna deck — name, faction, and what they do under the night.
roles.guideEditableHint: You can edit names and descriptions before dealing. Players will see your text when they reveal their role.
roles.roleDescriptionHint: Shown on the hold-to-reveal card. Keep it clear for new players.
roles.editorHelp: Lower call-order number = woken earlier in the night. “When they wake” and “What they do” drive the engine — nothing is hard-coded per role name.
roles.raisePriorityHelp: Use the arrows to swap call order with the neighbour above or below. Lower number wakes first.
roles.lowerPriorityHelp: Use the arrows to swap call order with the neighbour above or below. Lower number wakes first.
roles.copiesHelp: How many of this role are dealt. Set to 0 to leave it out of the deal (still listed for editing).
roles.maskingHelp: Minimum time this wake stays open (milliseconds). The turn never ends early when someone taps Confirm — that stops neighbours from guessing who acted by timing.

frequencyHelp.EVERY_NIGHT: Woken on every night of the game.
frequencyHelp.FIRST_NIGHT_ONLY: Woken only on night 1, then sleeps for the rest of the game.
frequencyHelp.ON_TRIGGER: Not woken automatically. Only enters the night queue if the Master forces a call (advanced).

actionHelp.NONE: This role is never woken for an action (typical Citizen).
actionHelp.SINGLE_TARGET: The awake player picks one living target (e.g. protect or strike).
actionHelp.FACTION_VOTE: All living members of this faction vote together on one victim (Shadow hunt).
actionHelp.INSPECT_TARGET: Pick one player; the result is private intel at dawn.
actionHelp.PASSIVE_INFO: Shows a short message only — no target to choose.

cittadino.name: Citizen
cittadino.description: Sleeps with no night power. Wins when the last Shadow falls at dawn or under the tribunal.

guardia.name: Keeper
guardia.description: Each night chooses one living player to shelter. If Shadows strike them, they survive until dawn.

baluardo.name: Bulwark
baluardo.description: Only on the first night may raise a shield over one living player, then returns to silence.

oracolo.name: Oracle
oracolo.description: At night investigates one living player and at dawn learns Village or Shadows.

lunavista.name: Moonseer
lunavista.description: On odd moon nights peers at one living player and at dawn learns their exact role.

veglia.name: Vigil
veglia.description: Does not act — only receives a short warning in the silence. Wins with the Village.

eco.name: Echo
eco.description: On even nights receives a warning that echoes who fell at the day’s tribunal.

legame.name: Bond
legame.description: Two linked souls: only on the first night they recognise each other in the dark. Wins with the Village. Always add two copies.

ombra.name: Shadow
ombra.description: Village infiltrator. At night the Shadows vote together on a victim to erase by dawn.

caccianotte.name: Night-hunter
caccianotte.description: Hunts with the pack: votes with the other Shadows on the night’s prey.

artiglio.name: Talon
artiglio.description: On even nights strikes alone, beyond the pack vote: chooses one living player to cut down.

simulacro.name: Simulacrum
simulacro.description: Looks like a Citizen and never wakes, but wins with the Shadows — without knowing who they are.

vagabondo.name: Wanderer
vagabondo.description: Lone wanderer: wins only if they remain the last one alive under the moon.

crocevia.name: Crossroads
crocevia.description: Neutral at the fork: wins only as the last survivor. On odd nights listens without acting.

invocatore.name: Invoker
invocatore.description: Does not wake alone: only if the Master calls them in the night do they receive a warning.

giudice_notte.name: Night Arbiter
giudice_notte.description: Each night investigates one living player and at dawn learns their exact role — the verdict stays private.

mannaia.name: Cleaver
mannaia.description: On odd nights may cut down one living player for the Village. A mistake is an eternal accusation.

crepuscolo.name: Twilight
crepuscolo.description: Wears two faces: by day looks like a Citizen, but wins only as last survivor. On the first night alone listens to both silences — then walks alone.

soglia.name: Threshold
soglia.description: On even nights investigates one living player and at dawn learns only Village or Shadows.

corvo.name: Raven
corvo.description: Each night receives a warning: mark a name in silence to bring into dawn accusations — no forced vote power.

fiamma_fredda.name: Cold Flame
fiamma_fredda.description: Only on the first night may strike alone, before the pack even moves.

reveal.title: Your identity
reveal.hint: Press and hold to reveal. Release to hide — no shoulder surfing.
reveal.waitingHost: Waiting for the Host to begin the night…

night.sleepHint: Eyes closed. No signals. Wait for the shared heartbeat.
night.submitted: Action recorded. Wait for the micro-turn to end…

hostApp.blurb: Start the LAN server. Players open the URL on their phones (or scan the lobby QR) — no Node install required.
hostApp.lanOnly: LAN URLs only (no loopback in QR)
hostApp.noLan: No LAN IP — connect Wi‑Fi or set an override.
